title: Single-level loop
summary: Use initialization, condition checking, and updating to control repeated task execution.
context: The flowchart sums the integers from 1 to n for a positive integer n: the running sum starts at 0, and each "Task" adds the current i to that sum.
result: When the task executes, i takes the values 1 through n in turn for n executions in total; once updated to i = n + 1, the condition is false and the loop ends.

frames.title: Single-level loop
frames.explanation: First initialize i = 1, then test i ≤ n. When true, execute the task, increment i by 1, and loop directly back to the condition check; when false, exit. Initialization runs only once before entering the loop rather than resetting i to 1 on every iteration.
